name: Can I convert an existing garage into a Studio ADU?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert an existing garage into a Studio ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing garage into a Studio ADU is a common and often cost-effective option, particularly in areas like Union City or Hayward where space is at a premium. This process typically involves structural modifications, adding insulation, updating electrical and plumbing systems, and ensuring the new living space meets all residential building codes. While potentially saving on foundation and framing costs, garage conversions might require significant upgrades to meet energy efficiency standards or address seismic requirements. A practical tradeoff is balancing the lower initial construction cost with potential expenses for extensive structural or utility overhauls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting a garage into a Studio ADU is feasible, especially in areas like Union City. It often saves on some construction costs but may require significant upgrades to meet modern building codes and standards.
